canDo: Can give an opinion with examples and add limits or the other side with opposition / concession.
review: Review cause and effect; add contrast and concession with cependant/pourtant/en revanche/malgré/bien que.
input: Listening: simple opinions; reading: a short text on both sides of a question.
output: Write a 130–140-word opinion; speak for 2.5 minutes with examples and a turn.
checkpoint: Your output follows opinion → reason → example → turn → conclusion.
challenge: Today’s challenge: on “Do smartphones make us lonelier?”, write a 5-sentence opinion: take a position, give an example from your own life, bring in the opposite view with mais / pourtant / même si, and end with a balanced conclusion; then record yourself for 2 minutes.
